|game_text=Deploys and moves like a starfighter. May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Your [Independent Starship] starships may deploy here as a 'react.' If [[Jabba]] here, immune to attrition.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3, the current text (version 4 of 4): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, official text as of 27 April 2013. It repeats word for word the text of [[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Block 3)]] (the original). It is the last publication of this card, so it is current; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image here is the Master List slip.
* '''Original''' ([[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Block 3)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 55E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> Full text: “Deploys and moves like a starfighter. May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Your [Independent Starship] starships may deploy here as a 'react.' If Jabba here, immune to attrition.” Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-55E-Jabbas_Space_Cruiser.png]]) prints slip number “55E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-jabbasspacecruiser-pre.gif]], slip number 54E, errata mark E) prints: “Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Your [Independent Starship] starships may deploy here as a 'react.' If Jabba here, immune to attrition.” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-2009">Lee Edwards' V-kit, [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips swccgvkit-legacy <code>public/images/vslips</code>] (commit 81e0048, migrated from svn on 28 May 2010; the <code>.svn/entries</code> files record svn r1 committed 2009-12-09T05:41:52Z for these slips). The file <code>virtual6-dark/jabbasspacecruiser.png</code> is the same image as the Players Committee card image (same words, slip number and errata mark), compared by eye on 11 November 2026.</ref>, so it was made by then. No firmer date is known (the card list carries no errata stamp for this wording), so it is placed at that proven upper bound, “by 9 December 2009” (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 08:23); the image may be older. '''What changed:''' compared with the original, the release sheet's “May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.” is turned round: “Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.” comes first. The PC website's image folder carries the same file with the server date 25 February 2013, a later bulk upload of the unchanged image. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 3 set mark) and prints the number “54E” bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “55E”).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) added “Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.”, removed “Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.”, changed “Your starships” to “Your [Independent Starship] starships” and changed “a 'react.' If” to “a 'react'. If”.<ref name="cl-1230_55-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> Full text: “Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Your [Independent Starship] starships may deploy here as a 'react'. If Jabba here, immune to attrition.” The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it. Compared with PC-E1 (the PC card image), the only change is that the full stop after 'react' moves outside the quote mark (“'react.'” becomes “'react'.”).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 54), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=54, page 54. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=54 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploys and moves like a starfighter. May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Your [Independent Starship] starships may deploy here as a 'react.' If Jabba here, immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC card image (PC-E1) and the PC website card list (PC-E2) had published different wordings. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1230-55-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right.
